acceptance_gate.condition: in_corpus_code_auroc present AND heldout_code_auroc present AND heldout_code_auroc_ci present AND leak_audit_findings present AND adversarial_verify_clean == true
acceptance_gate.principle: A trustworthy code-native verdict requires the suspicious 1.0 reproduced and explained, held-out AUROC + CI, the leak audit, and adversarial-clean.

field_principles.adversarial_verify_clean: True iff no critical flag and the suspicious 1.0 was explained, not hidden.
field_principles.code_signal_survives_heldout: BARE bool. False whenever held-out AUROC >=0.99; otherwise true iff held-out AUROC >0.5 with CI excluding 0.5.
field_principles.heldout_calibration_brier_ece: Calibration of the held-out code signal -- a deployable code operating point must be calibrated.
field_principles.heldout_code_auroc: The code-native AUROC on the DIFFERENT held-out corpus -- the real generalization number.
field_principles.heldout_code_auroc_ci: CI of the held-out AUROC -- must EXCLUDE 0.5 to count as signal; held-out 1.0 is still a leak flag.
field_principles.in_corpus_auroc_diagnosis: WHY the in-corpus AUROC is ~1.0 (separability / leakage / label-correlated feature).
field_principles.in_corpus_code_auroc: The exp3695 ~1.0 reproduced on the tuned corpus -- the suspicious number being audited.
field_principles.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates if cached-only (no marker); live_llm_inference only if a real live-model generation step ran (60s floor).
field_principles.leak_audit_findings: Honest record of separability, contamination, label-correlation, and verifier authenticity checks.
field_principles.leak_detected: BARE bool. True iff the in-corpus 1.0 is explained by leak/separability or held-out >=0.99.
field_principles.n_examples_heldout: Sample-size rigor on the held-out corpus.
